Hi Emily — following up with more detail from the Trust & Compliance side.

1) Report coverage and bridge letter
Our most recent Type II report covers the period 2025-04-01 through 2026-03-31. We will provide that report in PDF form. For the gap through 2026-06-30 we will provide a signed bridge letter that:
- States the audit period covered by the report;
- Confirms no material control changes affecting the scope occurred in the bridge window; and
- Notes retention and log sampling approach for that period.

2) Evidence sharing and redaction guidance
- Preferred ingestion: presigned S3 (recommended), then Google Drive. We will upload artifacts to a read-only, time-limited location.
- Redaction: we redact customer PII and third-party account secrets; otherwise we provide full screenshots, configuration exports, auth logs (scrubbed of user identifiers when necessary). If VaultCorp requires additional redaction, note that in your delegation tickets and we'll review.

3) Control mapping and delegated-owner template
- We'll attach a simple CSV mapping (control_id, control_description, artifact_filename) as part of the upload. That aligns with your auditor needs.
- The evidence-delegation-template we attached is a one-paragraph instruction you can paste into your ticketing tool; it includes suggested SLAs for artifact collection (5 business days) and a fallback route to our compliance team.

4) Timing and access
- We'll plan to upload the report + bridge letter + control mapping by Wed, Nov 25.
- For artifact collection, we'd like a 7-day window from the moment we share the intake checklist. If you need a longer period, tell us and we'll extend.

Attachments included with this message:
- redwood-soc2-intake-checklist.xlsx (checklist of artifacts and formats)
- draft-bridge-letter-template.docx (editable bridge letter)
- evidence-delegation-template.txt (paste-ready delegation snippet)
- control-mapping-sample.csv (sample mapping)

If helpful, Marissa and I can join a 20-min call to walk through the checklist with your procurement/audit team.
